title: D5b 'security:injection-surfaces' is a TRUE unrun gap, NOT covered by D5a: D5a's own coverage_manifest scopes it to memory hot-path store/recall call-sites + opc/*.py shell=True + skills docs. The cross-cutting injection-surface enumeration (scripts/*.mjs, MCP tool-arg interpolation, and non-memory shell sinks like the Grep router) was never swept until this gap-fill — and it surfaced two live S1 sinks D5a had explicitly down-rated to 'lower-risk'.
causal_links: D5a coverage_manifest line 'smart-search-router.ts:101 ... minor' is exactly the under-rating GAP4-01 corrects
telemetry: WF1-STATE.json lists 'D5b security:injection-surfaces' under failed_spend_limit (never ran). D5a.json coverage_manifest enumerates only store_learning/recall_learnings callers, opc/*.py, and scheduled .bat/.ps1 — it never sweeps scripts/*.mjs shell:true sites or the Grep/daemon shell path. A reader skimming the WF1 manifest could wrongly conclude 'injection covered by D5a' and skip the D5b re-run.
observe_how: Read D5a.json's coverage_manifest: it triages store_learning.py callers (agent-error-capture/hook-error-pipeline/user-confirmation-detector = the 3 S0/S1 it owns; periodic-extract/browser-learning-extractor/post-plan-roadmap/smarter-everyday = safe array form), recall_learnings.py callers in scripts/*.mjs (bus-quality-gate/code-intel/system-coherence-stress = array, clean), and opc/*.py shell=True (0 matches). It explicitly labels smart-search-router.ts:101 and daemon-client.ts:582/589 as 'lower-risk' / 'not user content' — both wrong (GAP4-01/02). The scripts/*.mjs shell:true sites swept here (system-coherence-stress.mjs x4, update-blocklist.mjs gh-api, backfill-intel-bus pure-IO, cdp.mjs npx array) are all CLEAN re: untrusted-input injection, and the memory-awareness RECALL hot path is a NOTABLE POSITIVE (spawnSync array args + sanitizeMemoryContent on DB-returned content, WS-0.2). Net: D5b's specific value — re-rating the two Grep/daemon sinks and clearing scripts/*.mjs + MCP-arg surfaces — required this run; the gap was real.
